featured_reviews.name: sanjay merai
featured_reviews.review_text:
⚠️ Real Experience Review – Fudboy Restaurant

Yesterday I visited Fudboy Restaurant for dinner with my family What started as a normal evening quickly turned into a very unpleasant experience — a cockroach was crawling on our dining table while we were eating
It was shocking and disappointing to see such poor hygiene in a place that serves food to the public Cleanliness is one of the most basic expectations every customer has when dining out and seeing pests in a food area clearly shows a lack of proper maintenance and hygiene standards
🪳 Why This Matters:
Cockroaches aren’t just a sign of unclean surroundings — they can spread bacteria that cause food poisoning infections, and allergies For any restaurant pest control and kitchen hygiene should be non-negotiable priorities

⚠️ Concerns:

Visible cockroach activity inside a dining area
Possible hygiene lapses in the kitchen or food storage areas
No immediate apology or action from the staff

✅ Suggestions for the Management:
Conduct a deep cleaning and pest control treatment immediately
Ensure regular hygiene audits
Train staff to respond quickly and appropriately when customers report such incidents

💬 My Takeaway:
I’m sharing this not to defame anyone but to raise awareness about the importance of food safety Every customer deserves a clean and hygienic dining experience. Incidents like this are reminders for all restaurants to take cleanliness seriously — not just for reputation but for people’s health
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We really apologise for the inconveniences caused. We always perform regular pest control after pest control slight like to be 🪳 some time but we always have our customer hygiene and safety first we try to ensure always server healthy and tasty food serve to customer with all the hygiene measure maintained.

featured_reviews.name: Ravin Tanwar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've always wanted to have quality food in Nalasopara. But it's almost impossible to find.a good place. My standards are a little high since I prefer hygienic and quality food with no ajinomoto or MSG. Fudboy offers just that. After trying all kind of restaurants I was unsatisfied and couldn't select my go to place for chinese or Thai food. So I decided to open a chinese place myself but I needed guidance since I've never run a business. So I asked around and my friend suggested I speak to Naved (Owner of Fudboy) in Nalasopara. So I met the guy and he guided me surprisingly I realized that Naveds motivation to run a food restaurant in Nalasopara is same as me (To bring quality food to Nalasopara)
Subtle things that he did that made Fudboy my go to place for Chinese or Food
1. He does not use stored pre cooked chicken (every dish is made from scratch)
2. Every dish has its authentic taste unlike these chinese corners
3. Quality standards are pretty high
4. Small things like chefs wearing hair nets etc
The Nalasopara crowd normally likes quick chinese food without looking for quality and authenticity of any dish
But at Fudboy every recipe I noticed is unique unlike the small chinese corners where all dishes taste the same
I genuinely loved the food and the hospitality at Fudboy
THIS IS MY GO TO PLACE FOR CHINESE FROM NOW ON

PS please try "Oil fry Chicken"
Naved's own creation
It's exceptional!

featured_reviews.review_text: The Vadapav at MAMA Vadapav is undoubtedly the star of the show. The soft and fluffy bun, generously stuffed with a delectable potato patty, topped with a flavorful assortment of chutneys and spices, creates an explosion of flavors with every bite. It's the perfect balance of spiciness, leaving me craving for more. The Samosas at MAMA Vadapav are equally impressive. The crispy exterior gives way to a mouthwatering filling of perfectly seasoned potatoes and spices. Each bite is like a burst of happiness in my mouth, and it's hard to resist ordering more. Whether you're a local or a tourist, this place will leave you satisfied and longing for your next visit. I can't wait to return and indulge in their delicious offerings once again!
